## Key Facts

- Product: 48V magnetic track lighting systems
- Track widths: 20mm (residential), 23mm (commercial), 35mm (heavy-duty)
- Installation: surface mounted, recessed, trimless recessed, pendant
- Light modules: flood, grille, folding grille, spot, pendant, linear, wall washer, sensor
- Smart control: Tuya (Zigbee/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), DALI 2.0, Casambi, 0-10V, Triac
- Certifications: CE, RoHS
- OEM/ODM: custom track length, RAL color finish, private label packaging, logo printing
- MOQ: no MOQ for standard items; MOQ applies for OEM production
- Lead time: standard 3-7 working days, OEM 20-30 days
- Contact: info@tracklinear.com | WhatsApp: +86-134-5080-2291
